name: A Fairy Special Night
source:
Another night wasted, a fairy-tale romance making a mockery of a dreary day-to-day existence, and a... a Fairy godfather??

Sometimes, a "click" is all that's needed.

"a Fairy special night" is a queer visual novel about a gay film school drop-out who finally takes a tentative step out of his social seclusion and into the daunting world of dating - helped by his very own fairy godfather and a dubious "wish-granting" website, where - apparently - "satisfaction is guaranteed"...?

[Edited from [url=https://pmscenarios.itch.io/fairy-special-night]itch.io[/url]]
